limitations: Only the official questions parquet is locally verified at this stage; no corpus baseline has run.
The corpus exposes doc_id, source_type, title, and content only. Thread, participant, timestamp, version, freshness, project, and ACL fields must not be inferred as gold metadata.
The benchmark company and documents are synthetic, although designed to simulate realistic company-internal data.
The official answer leaderboard uses GPT-5.4 as a judge; any local deterministic retrieval score must be reported separately.
Question qst_0413 contains the same expected document ID twice. The adapter preserves the raw list and exposes an order-preserving unique view for set-based retrieval metrics.
